svg.title: Control base: ESP32 DevKitC + 128x64 serial LCD + button + buzzer + LED
svg.text: Control base: ESP32 DevKitC + 128x64 serial LCD + button + buzzer + LED
LCD is one-way: GPIO17 (UART2 TX) -> converter LV1 -> HV1 -> backpack RX. Both converter GND pins are the same net.
Button: INPUT_PULLUP, no resistor. Buzzer + on GPIO32. LED long leg -> 1k -> GPIO25. Power: ESP32 USB.
